Package de.hof.dms.domain

Class EapSequence

java.lang.Object
de.hof.dms.domain.EapSequence
public class EapSequence extends Object
Counter document backing EAP-number generation, stored in the MongoDB eap_sequences collection. Each record holds the next sequence value (seq) for a given category/department/year combination, so unique EAP numbers can be allocated atomically.
